title: Gibson Vintage Reissue Electric Guitar Strings, Ultra-Light Gauge

long_description.body:
Gibson Vintage Reissue Electric Guitar Strings are a recreation of the formula developed by Gibson Master Luthiers in the 1950s, featuring a hex-shaped, tinned-steel core, precision-wound with pure nickel for durability, clarity, and warmth. Compared to nickel-plated steel, pure nickel strings offer a rounder, fuller, vintage-inspired tone with clear response and dynamic output. Versatile across genres, Gibson Vintage Reissue Electric Guitar Strings are factory-spec at Gibson Custom.



The hex-shaped, tinned steel core provides durability and volume, while the pure nickel wrap brings the timeless warm voice of vintage Gibson into the present
Uncoated for authentic electric feel and sound
Developed and tested by Gibson Master Luthiers on Gibson electric guitars since the 1950s
Made in the USA
Ultra-Light Gauge: .009, .011, .016p, .024, .032, .042
Light Gauge: .010, .013, .017p, .026, .036, .046
Medium Gauge: .011, .014, .018p, .030, .042, .050
